paragraphs: The morning begins with a client design review and adjustments to plans and facades. In the afternoon, the architect uses BIM to resolve service conflicts with structural and building-services teams and checks fire separation and clear height. Before drawing issue, repeated reviews examine daylight and corridor widths. A site visit checks construction details, followed by responses to design questions and changes. The day ends with an organized revision list for tomorrow's review.
